rule: A slot is done when the table stores a function in it and that function does work.
A function does no work when no return statement can return success: every return gives a failure constant (E_NOTIMPL, STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED, STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL and the other names in REFUSAL).

A function does no work when it only logs, counts, takes locks, reads state, reports an error or writes zeros: no call outside NEUTRAL and no write of a nonzero value through a pointer, a member or an index.
A function whose only work is one call to another function of the same driver is judged by that function.
A fail-safe entry of engine-ddi (FailSafe<...>) is not done. NULL is not done.
A done function that also refuses some inputs with a failure constant is marked partial. Partial counts as done.
